description: CLF-016 fail: the first push lands and then reports failure, a rival with our number is on origin, and origin refuses the deletion. A landed push is withdrawn whatever its exit code, so the withdrawal is attempted and refused: the refusal names the branch left on origin. Before the fix the withdrawal was skipped (the push had failed) and the claim renumbered past a stale branch. Differs from the pass direction only in the refused deletion.

.specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-f: # Fixture stub of .specify/scripts/powershell/create-new-feature.ps1. The contract scripts/claim-feature.ps1 reads:
# it is called as -Json -Number N -ShortName S <description>, must create branch NNN-S and specs/NNN-S/ and
# leave that branch checked out, and must print {"BRANCH_NAME":"NNN-S"} on stdout.
# A rival claim with our number reaches origin between allocation and the push (the race the loop exists for).
